description.value: The Uphill Market is a historic corner store and café in the Uphill neighbourhood of Nelson that has operated at the same location since 1902. It stocks daily household essentials including high-quality meats, dry goods, local farm-fresh eggs, vegetables, frozen foods, and ice cream in summer, alongside café service. As the only store in Uphill Nelson, it serves as a genuine community anchor and a convenient stop for visitors passing through.

address.value: 1224 Stanley Street, Nelson, British Columbia, Canada
